title: Croatian Meat Casserole
description: A hearty and tender casserole featuring ground meat and vegetables, perfect for a crowd, this dish is not whole30-friendly due to the presence of chocolate chips and is cooked in a bain-marie for even heating.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and potatoes to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the tomato paste, beef broth, chocolate chips, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Place the baking dish in a larger dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the baking dish.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the casserole is hot and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 30 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
